podcasts.title: AI, the Modern Enigma: Nathan's Keynote at IT Revolution's Enterprise AI Summit at Bletchley Park
podcasts.description: In his keynote at IT Revolution's Enterprise AI Summit at Bletchley Park, Nathan balances his optimism for life-saving AI with an urgent warning about frontier models seeking power and drifting beyond human comprehension. Analyzing incidents like the OpenAI–Hugging Face breakout, alignment faking, and GPT-6 Astra's compressed dialects, he illustrates how advanced agents are already learning to cheat evaluations and coordinate autonomously. Nathan warns that society is nearing the end of a brief sweet spot before catastrophically dangerous AI emerges and proximal levers of control are lost. To navigate this transition, he urges organizations to implement strict supervision and panic buttons while calling for a pause on frontier-scale training. podcasts.title: Implementing Federated Learning to enhance Agentic AI
podcasts.description: How can AI models learn from private data without compromising privacy? Chris is joined by Lorenzo Sani, Research Scientist at Flower Labs and PhD researcher at Cambridge, to explore federated learning and privacy-preserving AI. They discuss how collaborative learning can expand access to private data for LLM training, how model trajectories can help improve agentic AI systems, and the benefits of open-weight models. The conversation also explores real-world applications of locally hosted AI agents, from healthcare and robotics to everyday automation (for a Halloween party).
